title: Track coffee shop stock and plan weather-based promos
summary: At a Build with Gemini event in Jakarta, a developer built WarungBot, an agent that tracks a coffee shop's stock, records sales and suggests promotions based on the day's weather.
agent_role: The agent checks stock, records sales, reports weekly sales, suggests promotions from the weather and makes menu posters. The owner asks questions in chat.
outcome: Author shares a live demo built in one day at a hackathon.
what_they_did: A developer at a Build with Gemini event in Jakarta built a chat assistant for a coffee shop. It answers in Indonesian. Owners can ask which stock is running low, log sales, see weekly sales or ask for a promotion idea. It can also make a menu poster.
how_it_went: The author says it was built the same day and shares a working demo page.
prompt: Act as the assistant for my [type of shop] in [your city]. Keep a stock list in [a spreadsheet] and record each sale I tell you. Every morning, tell me which items are running low. Check today's weather and suggest one item to promote. Draft the promotion text, but don't post it anywhere until I approve.

curation.rationale: A hackathon prototype with a live demo for a coffee shop: stock tracking, sales logging and weather-based promotion ideas. It is early and thin on detail, but a genuine small-business use.
